notes:
Voice notes, a ready-made sample project, and screenshots in bug reports.

New: Voice notes — record straight into a board card or the Notes panel, name them, play and scrub them back
New: Sample project “Monsoon Letters” opens on first launch, and any time from Help or Settings
New: Bug reports can include screenshots or log files, and say how bad the problem is
Changed: The first-use tour is shorter and clearer
Changed: Sound on boards and in Notes uses a small player with a draggable playhead
Changed: About now says Built by Cutcult Studios LLP
Changed: Branded installers; the Windows app icon fills its tile
Fixed: Picking another lesson no longer closes the video tour, and the video is bigger
Fixed: Help, About and Report a bug work before a project is open
Fixed: Playing sound on a board no longer doubles up after you select another card
